entities.summary: The Rebuilding Korea Party is a South Korean political party founded by former Minister of Justice Cho Kuk ahead of the 2024 South Korean legislative election. The name of the party can be pronounced as 'Jo-guk Hyeok-sin Dang' in Korean. The word 'Jo-guk' refers to 'Fatherland' (Korea), but also refers to the name of the party founder Cho Kuk, which shares the same spelling in Korean. However, the Hanja is different. Cho Kuk resigned as party leader in December 2024 following the Supreme Court decision to uphold his two-year prison sentence for document falsification.
